source_passage_locator: K050S02: NIDDK Diabetic Kidney Disease → What is diabetic kidney disease?; How does diabetes cause kidney disease?
review_note: Reviewed NIDDK Diabetic Kidney Disease, particularly What is diabetic kidney disease? and How does diabetes cause kidney disease? NIDDK explains that diabetes-related damage to renal blood vessels impairs their function and that kidney damage can reduce blood filtration, resulting in diabetic kidney disease. These passages together support Damage to kidney blood vessels → Diabetic kidney disease as a possible progression. The vascular injury-to-disease connection is a synthesis of the two passages rather than a detailed step-by-step mechanism, and not every patient with renal vascular damage develops clinically recognized diabetic kidney disease. SRC008 provides related evidence of glucose-induced kidney-filter damage but was only partially supportive of the exact vascular intermediate and is therefore excluded from supporting_source_ids. AI-assisted review; human confirmation pending.
